parts.text: Build a remote-work hardware + software kit for 24 new hires under $45k shipping to Austin.

Configures 24 Standard tier workstation kits (IM-LPT-PRO14, IM-DCK-100W, IM-MON-27QHD, IM-PER-COMBO, IM-SW-SEC365, IM-WAR-NBD3Y) at $1,890.00 MSRP per kit. Verifies compatibility (65W laptop with 100W USB-C PD dock, shared HDMI/DisplayPort display interfaces, and 24 software seats within the 5-500 range on Windows 11 Pro) and confirms full stock in US-Central (Austin, TX). Applies the Silver Partner (10+) 5% discount ($1,795.50/kit, $43,092.00 total customer price, within the $45,000 budget) and recommends bumping from 24 to 25 kits to unlock the Gold Partner (25+) 12% discount ($41,580.00 total), saving the customer $1,512.00 while providing 1 extra kit.
Quote 10 performance studio kits with 16-inch laptops, 4K monitors, and wireless ANC headsets shipping to Harrisburg, PA with a budget of $3,000 per kit.

Configures 10 Performance tier workstation kits including the wireless ANC headset (IM-LPT-ULT16, IM-DCK-100W, IM-MON-32UHD, IM-PER-COMBO, IM-PER-ANC, IM-SW-SEC365, IM-WAR-NBD3Y) at $2,970.00 MSRP per kit. Confirms 100W USB-C PD compatibility, shared HDMI/DisplayPort/USB-C display interfaces, 10 software seats within 5-500 bounds, and 100% stock availability in US-East (Harrisburg, PA). Applies the Silver Partner (10+) 5% discount ($2,821.50/kit, $28,215.00 total), confirming compliance with the $3,000/kit budget.
We need 60 performance engineering kits shipping to Mira Loma, CA with a target budget of $2,200 per kit.

Configures 60 Performance tier workstation kits (IM-LPT-ULT16, IM-DCK-100W, IM-MON-32UHD, IM-PER-COMBO, IM-SW-SEC365, IM-WAR-NBD3Y) at $2,840.00 MSRP per kit. Applies the Platinum Partner (50+) 18% discount ($2,328.80/kit, $139,728.00 total), noting it exceeds the $2,200/kit budget by $128.80 per kit. Flags regional inventory shortfalls in US-West (Mira Loma, CA) for IM-LPT-ULT16 (30 available vs 60 requested) and IM-MON-32UHD (40 available vs 60 requested) and recommends a split shipment drawing remaining units from US-Central (Austin, TX) and US-East (Harrisburg, PA).
